candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business Yum! Brands, Inc. (YUM) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Yum! Brands is an asset-light franchisor of KFC, Taco Bell, and Pizza Hut. Nearly all system restaurants are franchised. Principal operations: Yum! Brands, Inc.. Reported segments include: Franchise and property revenues (88% of revenue); Company sales (12% of revenue). As of year end, approximately 98% of system restaurants were franchised and the remainder were company-operated.
